LanguageData.Cinder_HeadGear_DamagedScarf.label: damaged scarf
LanguageData.Cinder_HeadGear_DamagedScarf.description: A scarf with burnt edges and metal chain armor wrapped inside can provide some protection for the neck.
LanguageData.Cinder_HeadGear_GhostVeil.label: ghost veil
LanguageData.Cinder_HeadGear_GhostVeil.description: A strange ghost veil that looks like some kind of Halloween costume.
LanguageData.Cinder_HeadGear_ExoticVeil.label: exotic veil
LanguageData.Cinder_HeadGear_ExoticVeil.description: A faintly visible dancer's veil, paired with a golden headpiece, evokes vivid imagination.
LanguageData.Cinder_HeadGear_NightServiceVeil.label: night service veil
LanguageData.Cinder_HeadGear_NightServiceVeil.descrip: A silver crown and silk veil, evokes vivid imagination.
LanguageData.Cinder_HeadGear_MaidHeadwear.label: maid headwear
LanguageData.Cinder_HeadGear_ProjectionVisor.label: projection visor
LanguageData.Cinder_HeadGear_ProjectionVisor.descript: A sturdy mask that covers the user's mouth.
LanguageData.Cinder_HeadGear_AssaultHelmet.label: assault helmet
LanguageData.Cinder_HeadGear_AssaultHelmet.descriptio: A bulletproof helmet for assault missions, reinforced with plasteel, heavy but capable of providing effective defense.
LanguageData.Cinder_HeadGear_AssaultHelmetTan.label: assault helmet tan
LanguageData.Cinder_HeadGear_AssaultHelmetTan.descrip: A helmet made entirely of amorphous polymer as a bulletproof material.It can completely blocks psychic flows to prevent the user from being affected by psycast.
LanguageData.Cinder_HeadGear_GhoulUnitHelmet.label: ghoul unit helmet
LanguageData.Cinder_HeadGear_GhoulUnitHelmet.descript: The thermal imaging helmet used by the Ghoul unit can scan targets in complex tunnels.
LanguageData.Cinder_HeadGear_FullyEnclosedMask.label: fully enclosed mask
LanguageData.Cinder_HeadGear_FullyEnclosedMask.descri: A fully covered heavy-duty bulletproof mask reinforced with amorphous polymer, capable of providing protection for the entire head and resisting toxic environments. But its field of view is limited, affecting shooting accuracy.
LanguageData.Cinder_HeadGear_BrokenMask.label: broken mask
LanguageData.Cinder_HeadGear_BrokenMask.description: The damaged mask recovered from the battlefield is already worn out, but there is still a little protective ability.
